description_en: Retrieves the Copilot session and execution status
description_zh: 获取 Copilot 会话与执行状态
name: GetCopilotSession

parameters.help_en: The session ID. The value must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 会话 ID。长度为 1～64 个字符
parameters.name: session_id

activeTurn.description_en: The execution information of the turn that currently occupies the session
activeTurn.description_zh: 当前占用会话的执行信息

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 本轮执行创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

finishedAt.description_en: The end time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the execution has not finished
finishedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式。尚未结束时为空

inputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of input tokens for the current execution turn
inputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输入 Token 数

outputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of output tokens for the current execution turn
outputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输出 Token 数

pendingInputId.description_en: The ID of the form that is currently waiting for user input. This ID is used when submitting user input. This field is empty if there is no form to be filled
pendingInputId.description_zh: 当前等待用户填写的表单 ID。提交用户输入时使用；没有待填写表单时为空

turnId.description_en: The ID of the current execution turn. This ID is used when submitting user input, reconnecting, or stopping the execution
turnId.description_zh: 本轮执行 ID。提交用户输入、重新连接或停止执行时使用

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the session, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

cursor.description_en: The cursor of the latest persisted event in the current session
cursor.description_zh: 当前会话最新持久化事件的游标

lastTurn.description_en: The information about the most recent execution

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 本轮执行创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

finishedAt.description_en: The end time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the execution has not finished
finishedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式。尚未结束时为空

inputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of input tokens for the current execution turn
inputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输入 Token 数

outputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of output tokens for the current execution turn
outputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输出 Token 数

pendingInputId.description_en: The ID of the form that is currently waiting for user input. This ID is used when submitting user input. This field is empty if there is no form to be filled
pendingInputId.description_zh: 当前等待用户填写的表单 ID。提交用户输入时使用；没有待填写表单时为空

turnId.description_en: The ID of the current execution turn. This ID is used when submitting user input, reconnecting, or stopping the execution
turnId.description_zh: 本轮执行 ID。提交用户输入、重新连接或停止执行时使用

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the current execution turn, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

scheduledTask.description_en: The snapshot information when the scheduled task is triggered
scheduledTask.description_zh: 定时任务触发时的快照信息

runId.description_en: The ID of the current scheduled execution, which is used to associate with the scheduled execution record. Different triggers of the same scheduled task use different runIds
runId.description_zh: 本次调度执行 ID，用于关联调度执行记录。同一定时任务的多次触发使用不同的 runId

scheduledAt.description_en: The scheduled trigger time, in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This field is empty if there is no record
scheduledAt.description_zh: 计划触发时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。无记录时为空

startedAt.description_en: The time when the processing of the current schedule starts, in ISO 8601 format with time zone
startedAt.description_zh: 开始处理本次调度的时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式

taskId.description_en: The ID of the associated scheduled task

taskName.description_en: The name of the scheduled task at the time of this trigger. Subsequent changes to the task name do not affect this snapshot
taskName.description_zh: 本次触发时的定时任务名称。后续修改任务名称不会改变该快照

timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone of the scheduled task

sessionType.description_en: The session source. Valid values: openapi (active API call), cron (scheduled task), im_dingtalk (DingTalk), im_feishu (Lark), and alert (alert)
sessionType.description_zh: 会话来源。取值：openapi，主动调用；cron，定时任务；im_dingtalk，钉钉；im_feishu，飞书；alert，告警

status.description_en: The session status. Valid values: active (not archived) and archived (archived)
status.description_zh: 会话状态。取值：active，未归档；archived，已归档

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time of the session, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

message.description_en:
The error message.
If `code == Success`, this field is empty.
Otherwise, this field contains the request error message
message.description_zh:
错误信息
如果 `code == Success`，则本字段为空；
否则本字段包含请求错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于全链路诊断
